title: An app with no terminal: 30 s after Cmd-Q, a crash or SIGKILL no cmux-tui or acpmux of its sessions runs
why: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS: Lawrence's Mac had 380 cmux-tui processes with parent 1 from old tagged DEV apps. Fleet repro on build 3a43a131 (2026-11-04): with no terminal, Cmd-Q, SIGTERM, SIGKILL and a crash all left the app session's owner (cmux-tui --headless --session cmux-app-...), the Chief session's owner (cmux-chief-...), each one's screen detection plugin, and the acpmux daemon and router running with parent 1; only Quit and End Sessions ended them. They keep nothing a person can see: their state is durable and the next launch starts them again. The journey makes one terminal (evidence that the app works), resets with End Everything (no terminal), then quits by Cmd-Q, a crash and SIGKILL. It expects agents off (the capture slot's default).
source: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS (handoff/rewrites/R-LIFECYCLE/DESIGN.md section 8), fleet repro rlc-orphans-base-3..6
